Grep shows that 'iff' now appears only in the amended or superseded text. All 23 REQs are mapped in §7. units.json parses. pytest 2 passed; ruff clean. DELIVER: PR body updated; PR still draft, not merged. No production code changed. Open compliance note O-C (STD-GOV-7): the platform appends a Co-Authored-By trailer with a personal identifier.
